input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
rm -rf "$S/nat"; mkdir -p "$S/nat"
T0=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
~/.local-whisper/bin/lw-record "$S/nat" 1 16000 > "$S/nat.out" 2> "$S/nat.err" &
P=$!
sleep 20
kill -INT $P; wait $P 2>/dev/null
T1=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
python3 -c "print(f'   wall clock (incl. device open) = {$T1-$T0:.2f} s')"
echo "--- stderr ---"; cat "$S/nat.err"
echo "--- stdout head/tail ---"; head -2 "$S/nat.out"; tail -2 "$S/nat.out"
echo "--- chunks ---"
ls -l "$S/nat"/*.wav | awk '{s+=$5;n++} END {printf "   files=%d  totalAudio=%.3f s\n", n, (s-n*44)/32000}'
echo "--- per-chunk durations (first 8) ---"
for f in $(ls "$S/nat"/*.wav | head -8); do printf "   %s " $(basename $f); /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$f"; done
